title: The classical tangent space of a linear subspace at any of its points is the subspace itself
statement: For every linear subspace P of ℝ^N and every y ∈ P, classicalTangentSpace P y = P. Here classicalTangentSpace P y is the set of ξ such that some γ : ℝ → ℝ^N is C¹ on (−1,1), maps (−1,1) into P, satisfies γ(0) = y, and has derivative ξ at 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Euclidean N)) (y : Euclidean N), y ∈ P → classicalTangentSpace (P : Set (Euclidean N)) y = (P : Set (Euclidean N))
